name: web-gateway
description: HTTP REST + SSE + WebSocket gateway. Runs as axum server inside the network namespace. Provides /v1/chat (REST), /v1/chat/stream (SSE), and /v1/ws (WebSocket).
note: This channel is NOT a WASM component — it runs as native axum inside the agent process. Listed here for registry consistency.

auth_token.description: Bearer token for /v1/* endpoints. Empty = no auth (dev only).
